hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git commit'; then REPO_ROOT=$(dirname "$(cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null && pwd)") && PRETTIER="$REPO_ROOT/node_modules/.bin/prettier" && [ -x "$PRETTIER" ] && "$PRETTIER" --write . --log-level warn && git add -u; fi
